notes.title: 1.0.2 — Dilemma & Save Game Hotfix.
notes.notes:
- A number of performance-related optimizations.
- Graphical errors on the front of the Conservatory.
- Savegame functionality on certain storage disk hardware fixed.
- Additional player stats tracked in the save file.

Happy researching, my fellow Arcanists!

notes.title: Update 0.5.0.3
notes.notes:
My dear apprentices,

Demo version 0.5 releases with a new tutorial (we heard you, too much text!), a guide and library for players to find specific things they're confused on, and tons of new visual effects! Arcanum (money) has also been rebalanced, you will now have to save one or two apprentices to build a successful Conservatory.

Unless you succumb to war profiteering. 

Good luck!
The High Arcanist.
